_readme: Primitive parameter sheet for JobNavigator v2, transcribed from the code at branch v2-redesign, HEAD 539da1e. Read-only capture: every value here is quoted from source, never inferred. Where the code leaves something undefined the value is the literal string "unspecified". Paths are repo-relative. Line numbers are from the commit named in meta.

meta.head: 539da1e8ab3e977e682904cf83ed6bc3541bed47
meta.naming_note: There is no `MenuLabel` export. The menu caption row is `MenuHead` (ui.jsx:491).

decisions_recorded_verbatim: skins may set radius/shadow/border-width: yes — geometry tokens become per-skin, the skin proof becomes 'only tokens may differ'
new tokens/variants: allowed as additions defaulting to today's values

token_layers.model: theme.css has two layers. (1) A PALETTE block of literal colours/fonts, repeated per theme and per skin. (2) A SEMANTIC block whose every value is `var(--palette-token)`. Primitives read semantic names only; a skin replaces the palette block wholesale. `theme.css` and `ui.jsx` are the only two files where a literal is allowed (enforced by v2-testing/tools/stylelint.py).
token_layers.semantic_block_duplication_reason_quoted: The block is repeated verbatim in the dark selector below: identical by construction today, but the duplication is what lets a future skin re-point a semantic token at a *different* palette token per theme. Change one, change both.

semantic_tokens_read_by_primitives._note: Deduped `var(--x)` occurrences in ui.jsx, Toast.jsx and ConfirmDialog.jsx. 182 distinct names. `--ring-shift-sm` / `--ring-shift-md` are read through a template literal (`var(--ring-shift-${size === 'sm' ? 'sm' : 'md'}, …)`, ui.jsx:962), so a plain grep shows the stem `--ring-shift-` only.

primitive_layer_leaks_palette_tokens._note: Contrary to the file's own rule ("Primitives read semantic tokens only; they never read a palette token directly"), these palette names are read straight out of the primitive layer.

hover_paint_lives_in_css_not_in_jsx._note: Inline styles cannot express :hover, so every hover swap is a class in theme.css and uses !important to beat the primitive's own inline declaration. These tokens are therefore read by theme.css, not by ui.jsx.

dead_tokens._method: Every `--x:` definition in theme.css collected (308 distinct names), then every `var(--x)` occurrence in frontend/src/**/*.{js,jsx,css,html} + frontend/index.html. A token counts as live if it is read by a painting declaration, by JS, or (transitively) by another live token's value. `--ring-shift-sm` / `--ring-shift-md` were added by hand because they are read through a template literal.

alias_only._note: Live, but never read directly by a paint rule or by any JS — they exist only to feed another token. Candidates if the layer is ever flattened.

font_stacks.webfont_loading: frontend/index.html:13 loads Newsreader + Public Sans + JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts. No other skin loads a webfont — alt/tone*/editorial/cobalt/saas/win98 use system fallbacks (cobalt names IBM Plex but does not load it).

type_scale.root_line_height: unspecified — inherited (Tailwind preflight's 1.5 on the v1 shell). `.v2-ctl { line-height:1 }` is the opt-out for fixed-height controls.
type_scale.line_height_rule_quoted: LINE-HEIGHTS are whole pixels. Fixed-height flex controls carry `v2-ctl` (line-height:1) the way the rest of v2 does; a single line centred in a fixed box renders identically at any line-height, so that is pixel-safe.

radius_scale.--radius-mark: 3px — inline diff highlight behind running text
radius_scale.--radius-inline: 4px — inline mono chip, the 14-16px tick box
radius_scale.--radius-mini: 5px — the 17-22px square control (checkbox, paragraph button, funnel bar)
radius_scale.--radius-cell: 8px — pick cell / small panel between the row and the card

shadow_scale.not_re_skinned: The --shadow-* family is deliberately excluded from every skin block (black alphas, already theme-neutral; their offsets are part of the geometry the skin gate pins).

z_index_layers._note: There is no named z-index scale. Every value is a literal, most of them at the call site rather than in a primitive.

owned_by_primitives.ConfirmDialog / PromptDialog: 70 — they take ModalPanel's default and rely on DOM order: 'it mounts last in the tree, and equal z-index resolves in DOM order' (ConfirmDialog.jsx:13-15)

used_by_screens.2: sticky TableHead inside a modal (Companies.jsx:984, Searches.jsx:830)
used_by_screens.20: Feed grab-line strip (JobFeed.jsx:1169); Settings typeahead listbox (Settings.jsx:1054)
used_by_screens.39: click-away backdrop under a popover (CoverLetters.jsx:66, Stats.jsx:721)
used_by_screens.40: popover / row-action Menu (Applications.jsx:58, Companies.jsx:557, CoverLetters.jsx:24, Searches.jsx:678, Stats.jsx:722)
used_by_screens.44 / 45: click-away backdrop / Menu for header menus (JobFeed.jsx:123-124,1218-1219, ResumeEditor.jsx:599-600,633-634, Companies.jsx:456)
used_by_screens.59 / 60: Feed row-menu backdrop (59) and every screen modal (60)
used_by_screens.70: ModalPanel default (ConfirmDialog, PromptDialog, LoginModal panel body)

z_index_layers.documented_ordering_quote: z-index 80 is what puts a toast over an open modal (70) and drawer (30). (Toast.jsx:89)

hairline_model.half_pixel_borders: none — there is no 0.5px border anywhere in v2. The only sub-pixel border value in the primitive layer is the Spinner's 1.5px ring (ui.jsx:87).
hairline_model.half_pixel_avoidance_rule: Line-heights are pinned to whole pixels precisely so a 1px border never lands on a half pixel; see the Heading-strong table (ui.jsx:1258-1265) and the `useSnapTop` translateY correction (hooks.js:60-83) that pulls a flex-centred modal panel back onto the pixel grid.
hairline_model.borderWidth_shorthand_property: never used — every border is written as the `border`/`borderTop`… shorthand string

fields.reason_quoted: The 2px ring is gone: browsers apply :focus-visible to text inputs on *mouse* focus too, so every click drew a rectangle — and on the borderless inputs (Applications, Settings, Resumes, Cover Letters) it floated around nothing. A field now signals focus the way it draws itself at rest: a bordered box turns its border accent, an underline input turns its underline accent.

keyboard_ring_non_input_controls.reason_quoted: Keyboard-only ring on non-input controls — :focus-visible never fires on these from a mouse click, so this one stays as it was.
keyboard_ring_non_input_controls.consequence: The ring selector keys on `[tabindex="0"]`, so any control that act() has switched to tabIndex -1 (every disabled/busy primitive) loses the ring while remaining focusable.

focus_recipe.focus_trap: unspecified — no primitive traps focus, sets initial focus, or restores focus on close. ModalPanel and Drawer only wire Escape and a scrim click.
focus_recipe.select_trigger: The Select trigger is a div with tabIndex 0, so it takes the keyboard ring, not the field border-accent.

keyboard_helper_kb.code: export const kb = (fn, role = 'button') => ({ tabIndex: 0, role, onKeyDown: (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); fn(e) } } })
keyboard_helper_kb.duplicates: Same contract is re-declared in ResumeSections.jsx and Settings.jsx — 'declared here rather than imported so `ui.jsx` stays a leaf of the v2 import graph'.

act_wrapper.code: const act = (fn, off, role) => (fn ? (off ? { role: role || 'button', tabIndex: -1 } : { onClick: fn, ...kb(fn, role) }) : {})
act_wrapper.semantics: No handler at all when there is nothing to click (an inert Card is not a button). A disabled/busy control KEEPS its role and its aria-disabled/aria-busy, and loses only the interactivity: no handlers, tabIndex -1 so it leaves the tab order while staying focusable (and focused, if it already was) — DS-B-01.

disabled_recipe_per_primitive._note: There is no single disabled token or opacity. Five different opacities are in use plus one token-swap variant.
disabled_recipe_per_primitive.Button: token swap, no opacity: primary/danger → --btn-primary-disabled-bg on --btn-primary-disabled-ink; secondary → --btn-secondary-disabled-ink + --btn-secondary-disabled-border; ghost → --btn-secondary-disabled-ink on transparent. `opacity: busy && !disabled ? 0.6 : 1` — so a *busy* button dims, a *disabled* one does not. Hover class dropped. cursor default. aria-disabled. tabIndex -1.
disabled_recipe_per_primitive.Pill: opacity 0.5, cursor default, hover class dropped, aria-disabled, tabIndex -1
disabled_recipe_per_primitive.IconButton: opacity 0.5, cursor default, hover class dropped, aria-disabled, tabIndex -1
disabled_recipe_per_primitive.DashedAdd: opacity 0.5, cursor default, hover class dropped, aria-disabled
disabled_recipe_per_primitive.MenuItem: opacity 0.5, cursor default, hover class dropped, aria-disabled; the <a> form drops onClick
disabled_recipe_per_primitive.Chip: opacity 0.5, cursor default, hover class dropped, aria-disabled
disabled_recipe_per_primitive.Segmented: opacity 0.5 on every cell, cursor default, hover class dropped, all cells tabIndex -1, no pick handler
disabled_recipe_per_primitive.ChoiceCard: opacity 0.45, cursor default, hover class dropped, aria-disabled
disabled_recipe_per_primitive.ChoiceRow: opacity 0.45, cursor default, hover class dropped, aria-disabled
disabled_recipe_per_primitive.MoveArrows: opacity 0.35 per arrow (upOff/downOff), cursor default, v2-navlink class dropped, aria-disabled

durations_found.260ms: Toast leave-to-unmount timer (Toast.jsx:39) — deliberately 10ms longer than the 250ms transition
durations_found..2s: screen-level opacity fades (5 sites in screens)

reduced_motion.gap: The spinner animation, the Switch knob, the toast enter/leave and the warm-start fade are NOT covered.

theme_and_skin_mechanism.store: frontend/src/v2/theme.js — a `useSyncExternalStore` singleton. Nothing reads localStorage from a component.
theme_and_skin_mechanism.resolved: `system` resolves live from `prefers-color-scheme` via matchMedia; `resolved` is light|dark, `mode` is what the user picked.

attribute_hosts.<html>: data-theme, data-skin, plus the classic shell's `.dark` class — stamped by the inline boot script in index.html BEFORE React mounts, re-stamped by theme.js apply() on every change. Boot copy only, not a second source of truth.
attribute_hosts.every .jn-v2 root: the same two attributes, mirrored through React props via `themeAttrs(state)`. theme.css selects on the .jn-v2 root itself.

no_flash_boot.script: frontend/index.html:22-42 — reads jobnavigator_theme (migrating the old boolean), resolves `system` through matchMedia, sets data-theme/data-skin on <html> and toggles `.dark`, all inside a try/catch so a blocked localStorage falls back to the default light theme.
no_flash_boot.ground_rules: frontend/index.html:51-70 — a `:root[data-skin=…][data-theme=…] { background: <hex> }` pair per skin, 18 rules, so the pre-mount ground already matches. This is the ONLY place a palette value is written outside theme.css.
no_flash_boot.specificity_note_quoted: `:root[...]` is (0,2,0), which beats index.css's `html.dark` (0,1,1) deterministically whatever order Vite emits the stylesheets in.

what_a_skin_block_may_contain_today.shape: Two CSS blocks per skin — `.jn-v2[data-skin="X"]` and `.jn-v2[data-skin="X"][data-theme="dark"]` — each declaring the IDENTICAL set of 60 token names.
what_a_skin_block_may_contain_today.verified: All 8 non-default skins × both modes declare exactly the same 60 names (checked programmatically at this commit).
what_a_skin_block_may_contain_today.composition: 54 palette colours + 3 ScoreRing optical-centring offsets + 3 font stacks.
what_a_skin_block_may_contain_today.identical_set_rule_quoted: The two blocks MUST declare the identical set of names. `[data-skin="alt"]` and `.jn-v2[data-theme="dark"]` weigh the same (0,2,0), so a token that the light skin block sets and the dark one forgets would beat the default dark value and leak a light colour into the dark skin.
deliberately_not_re_skinned: the --cc-* ATS badge family (17 pairs) and --sm-* search-mode family (6 pairs) — 'an identity taxonomy, not theme colour'
the --shadow-* family — 'black alphas, already theme-neutral — and their offsets are part of the geometry the gate pins'
--rail-active, --rail-hover, --on-rail-line, --on-rail-dim, --on-rail-sep — 'white alphas that work on any dark rail'
--knob, --iframe-bg — 'a switch knob and an embedded document are white in either theme'
what_a_skin_block_may_contain_today.what_a_skin_CANNOT_express_today: --radius-*, --shadow-*, --t-* and every primitive's border width live in the shared semantic layer, not in the skin block. theme.css:670-678 records that the cobalt/saas/win98 boards change radii, border widths, bevels, shadows and the type scale, and that 'that is the part a skin cannot express'; v2-testing/round-design/skins-boards.md lists the delta per board.
what_a_skin_block_may_contain_today.current_gate: v2-testing/round-design/expected-D6.md + tools/stylecrawl.py + stylediff.py — 'switching data-skin may change colour and font family and nothing else: sizes, padding, radii, line-heights, border widths and shadow offsets are untouched by construction'.

ring_offsets_per_skin._why: The ScoreRing numeral is optically centred per skin because the display face's figure metrics differ.

alt.note: Georgia/Inter metrics: digits sit lower, the small-caps label higher — pixel-measured against the default skin, see v2-testing/round-design/ring-sizes.md

ring_offsets_per_skin.board_skins_note_quoted: all three boards put a SANS with lining figures in the display slot (IBM Plex Sans / system-ui / Tahoma)… So all three seed at the DEFAULT offsets and the ink measurement re-run after the build sets the final values.

global_resets..jn-v2 .v2-menu > *: flex-shrink:0 — 'Menu rows are fixed-height by definition; a scrolling menu scrolls, it never squashes.'

Button.element: div by default; `as="button"` renders a real <button type={type}> for the one case where the element IS the semantics (a form submit — LoginModal). The UA button styles are reset first: margin 0, border none, appearance none, WebkitAppearance none; tabIndex stays 0.

geometry.icon_size: unspecified — an icon is just a child glyph

states.hover: secondary → .v2-bdc:hover { border-color:var(--pill-border-hover) !important; color:var(--pill-ink-hover) !important; }  ·  ghost → .v2-hover-accent:hover { background:var(--hover-wash-bg) !important; color:var(--hover-wash-ink) !important; }  ·  primary and danger have NO hover rule — BTN_LOOK.primary.hover and .danger.hover are the empty string
states.disabled: variant.off tokens, cursor default, hover class dropped, aria-disabled, role kept, tabIndex -1
states.busy: same as disabled for interactivity, plus opacity 0.6 and a leading <Spinner size={12} color="currentColor" />, aria-busy true
states.focus_visible: box-shadow 0 0 0 2px var(--focus-ring) via [tabindex="0"]:focus-visible — lost when disabled/busy (tabIndex -1)

Button.motion: none — v2-bdc and v2-hover-accent carry no transition
Button.composition: children render inline after the optional spinner; fixed height, content width

accessibility.tab_stop: yes when live, tabIndex -1 when off
accessibility.min_hit_size: 28px tall at xs — below the 44px WCAG target size, unspecified as a rule

states.hover: .v2-bd:hover { border-color:var(--pill-border-hover) !important; } — border only, no wash. An ON pill's border is already --pill-on-border (= --accent) and --pill-border-hover is also --accent, so an ON pill has NO visible hover feedback.
states.selected_on: the `on` prop — the on-trio above, aria-pressed true
states.disabled: opacity 0.5, cursor default, v2-bd dropped, aria-disabled, tabIndex -1

geometry.width_and_height: = the `size` prop (26 or 36; any other number keeps the small look at that box)

states.selected_on: `on` (36 only in practice — at 26 the `on` prop is ignored by the look map), aria-pressed
states.disabled: opacity 0.5, cursor default, hover class dropped, aria-disabled, tabIndex -1

IconButton.known_gap: A size other than 26 or 36 gets the small look at that box — the intermediate is undefined.

states.hover: unspecified — no hover rule for fields
states.readOnly: passes through to the element; no distinct paint — unspecified
states.invalid/error: unspecified — no error token or state exists

Input.composition: Controlled by `value`; passing `defaultValue` instead renders it uncontrolled (Applications' autosaving notes box). `...rest` forwards any extra DOM prop (autoFocus, onKeyDown, onFocus — all used by PromptDialog).

accessibility.label_element: not rendered — a caller pairs it with `Label htmlFor`

geometry.single_line_basis: 19px line + 2×5.5px padding + 2×1px border = 32px, the same box a one-line Input draws

Textarea.states: identical to Input (focus border-accent, disabled opacity 0.6)

boxed (default).glyph: ⌕, absolute left 12, top 50% translateY(-50%), fontSize --t-12, color --search-glyph, pointer-events none, aria-hidden

SearchInput.wrapper_width_reason_quoted: the wrapper carries a real `width`, not just a flex-basis. A flex item's *intrinsic contribution* to its parent is measured from its content, and the content here is a bare <input> whose default intrinsic width is ~178px…

states.focus_visible: border-color (boxed) / border-bottom-color (underline) → --input-border-focus, from the same theme.css:1018 rule

accessibility.role: native searchless textbox — `type="search"` is not used

Select.element: span wrapper (position relative, stopPropagation on click) + a div trigger + a div listbox panel

variants.mono: value text → --font-mono at --t-11-5 instead of --font-body at --t-12-5

Select.trigger_bg_note_quoted: the trigger is a *field*, so it takes --input-bg like Input and Textarea. It shipped on --search-bg (= --surface, white) and any form that pairs a Select with an Input… drew two backgrounds for one row of controls.

empty_state.text: the `emptyText` prop, default 'Nothing to pick yet.'

states.focus_visible: keyboard ring on the trigger (it is a div with tabIndex 0, not an <input>)

behaviour.open_close: click toggles; a document-level click listener closes it
behaviour.escape: a CAPTURE-phase keydown listener, registered only while open, calls preventDefault + stopPropagation and closes the listbox only — so a Select inside a modal does not take the modal down with it (useEscape listens in the bubble phase, and capture always runs first)

accessibility.trigger: role button (via act), aria-haspopup="listbox", aria-expanded, aria-label, aria-disabled
accessibility.options: role="option" + aria-selected, each its own tab stop via kb()
accessibility.gaps: no arrow-key navigation, no typeahead, no aria-activedescendant, no aria-controls, no focus move into the panel — unspecified

flush.why: a full-bleed table row (Companies): the list has no side padding, so a 7px radius would round the hover fill away from the pane edges

Row.selection_rule_quoted: selection is a **background wash and nothing else**. APPS-20 added a 3px --row-selected-mark bar with a compensating left pad; Applications never had one (nor does any other row list in v2), and the pad swap shifted every cell in the picked row by 3px. The token went with it.

states.disabled: unspecified — Row takes no disabled prop
states.focus_visible: keyboard ring when onClick is set

Row.composition: `...rest` carries the data-* hooks a screen relies on (the Feed keys scroll-into-view and its harness selectors off data-row={i}). Fixed height. cursor:pointer only when onClick is present — 'an inert row leaves `cursor` unset so its text keeps the I-beam'.
sibling_row_classes_in_theme_css: .v2-cactions (Companies pinned actions cell) → --bg at rest, --row-hover under .v2-crow:hover

static (default).cursor: unset — inherited, so card text keeps the I-beam

Card.note: `interactive` (or any onClick) applies `v2-act`, which has NO transition. The `v2-card` class — same hover paint but WITH `transition:border-color .12s,background .12s` — is a separate class applied by screens, not by the primitive.
Card.composition: `id` and a forwarded ref are zero-pixel pass-throughs (Stats scrolls two cards into view and deep-links one by #runs).

variants.interactive: defaults to TRUE (unlike Card) — pass interactive={false} for an inert band

geometry.padding: unspecified — none set; the box is height-only, width is the parent's

DashedAdd.motion: .v2-dashadd { transition:border-color .12s,background .12s; } — note the hover also moves `color`, which is NOT in the transition list

states.disabled: opacity 0.5, cursor default, v2-dashadd dropped, aria-disabled

Menu.flex_shrink_reason_quoted: The box is a *column* flex container, so a child's declared height is only a flex-basis: once the menu is taller than its `maxHeight` (the Feed's Company filter lists ~1300 companies), the browser shrinks every shrinkable child to fit, and the in-menu search field collapsed from its canonical 32 px to 17.
Menu.composition: Positioning is entirely the caller's, passed as `style` (usually position absolute under a trigger, with an explicit zIndex — 40/45/50 in the screens).

accessibility.role: `role` prop, default 'menu'; 'listbox' for an option picker (Settings typeahead, the cover-letter template/paper pickers)
accessibility.gaps: no roving focus, no arrow-key navigation, no focus trap, no return-focus — each MenuItem is its own tab stop. Escape is not wired inside Menu; callers wire their own click-away backdrop div.

MenuHead.props: children, style only — no className, no id, no role

MenuItem.element: div; `href` renders a real <a> (textDecoration none, rel="noreferrer" when target="_blank") so a navigating row stays ⌘/middle-clickable

danger.divider: defaults to TRUE — a borderTop 1px solid --menu-item-sep above it; pass divider={false} for a danger item that is not the last of its menu

geometry.icon_gutter: flex 0 0 16px, flex-centred, fontSize --t-11, color --label-ink (no colour when danger)
geometry.hint: trailing <Helper size="xs" mono={hintMono}> at flex 0 0 auto; colour becomes `inherit` when the row is selected

states.disabled: opacity 0.5, cursor default, hover class dropped, aria-disabled; the <a> form drops onClick but keeps the href
states.focus_visible: keyboard ring (div form). The <a> form has no tabIndex from act() — it is focusable as a link.

slots: icon (fixed 16px gutter, a flex box so a 14/15px checkbox centres in it)
composition.truncation: `ellipsis` prop turns on nowrap/overflow hidden/text-overflow ellipsis on the label slot only

accessibility.role: `role` prop, default 'menuitem'; 'option' inside a listbox Menu

boxed.why: a hover target slightly larger than the label — the form the Feed's report heads use

caret.positions: 'start' (default) · 'end' (last, adjacent to the last child) · 'pin' (last, marginLeft auto) · false (none — the caller draws its own, e.g. the cover-letter editor's rotating SVG chevron)
caret.style: flex 0 0 auto, fontSize --t-10, lineHeight 1, color --label-ink, aria-hidden
caret.lineHeight_reason_quoted: without one the caret box is the row's 18px line-height, and in a `alignItems:'baseline'` head a 10px glyph in an 18px box sits at a font-dependent offset from the shared baseline, so the head grew 36→37px under the alt skin
caret.rendered_only_when: onToggle is present AND caret is truthy

states.hover: class from the `hover` prop, default 'v2-hover-accent' → background --hover-wash-bg, color --hover-wash-ink; applied only when onToggle is present

SectionHead.composition: children render as-is; `count` appends a <Helper size="xs"> at flex 0 0 auto after the children and before an end/pin caret

states.hover: .v2-chip:hover { border-color:var(--chip-border-hover) !important; background:var(--chip-bg-hover) !important; color:var(--chip-ink-hover) !important; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--chip-ring-hover) !important; } — applied only when onClick is present and not disabled
states.disabled: opacity 0.5, cursor default, hover class dropped, aria-disabled

none.why_quoted: the ATS / search-mode / tier badges are a separate hue taxonomy that theme.css paints from a `cc-*` / `sm-*` class, and an inline tone would beat that class

external_hue_taxonomy.classes: cc-greenhouse · cc-workday · cc-lever · cc-ashby · cc-phenom · cc-oraclehcm · cc-smartrecruiters · cc-rippling · cc-eightfold · cc-talentbrew · cc-meta · cc-google · cc-generic · cc-tier1 · cc-tier2 · cc-tier3 · cc-tiernone · sm-keyword · sm-levels · sm-lipersonal · sm-jobright · sm-freehire · sm-extension
external_hue_taxonomy.recipe_quoted: Badge palette (Badge Palette.dc.html): 8 hues, one oklch recipe per mode. light bg L.94/C.03 + ink L.45/C.09 · dark bg L.32/C.05 + ink L.84/C.07 — all pass AA. Tier chips are a separate taxonomy and are not part of that badge set.

Tag.states: none — Tag has no hover, active, disabled or focus state

geometry.size: the `size` prop, default 7 (a raw px number, not a token)

Check.element: span (role="checkbox") wrapping an aria-hidden indicator span + an optional label span

Radio.note: There is no radiogroup wrapper for Radio — the caller owns grouping. Segmented is the primitive that ships role="radiogroup".

geometry.wrapper: flex alignItems center, gap 7, flex 0 0 auto

Segmented.element: div role="radiogroup" with div role="radio" cells

inset (the framed two-cell toggle — the.group: flex 0 0 auto, padding 2, background --seg-inset-bg, border 1px solid --seg-border, radius --radius-control, gap 2

With a per-size viewBox, `r=35 + stroke/2` is a *fixed 37.5px* outer radius whatever the box is: it fits md's 44px box (37.5 < 44) and overflowed sm's 34px one, where the SVG root's UA `overflow:hidden` sliced 1.75px off all four sides — the ring rendered as a squircle.

known_exceptions._method: Two sweeps across frontend/src/v2/*.jsx (excluding ui.jsx). (a) every `ui: keep` marker — a role the primitive layer deliberately does NOT cover, each with the reason written at the site. (b) every `style={{…}}` passed INTO a primitive that sets geometry or colour (height, minHeight/maxHeight, padding, border*, radius, background, color, boxShadow, fontSize/Weight/Family, lineHeight, letterSpacing, textTransform, opacity). Pure-layout overrides (margin, flex, gap, position, zIndex, overflow, minWidth:0, textAlign, cursor) are not exceptions and are not listed.

unspecified_for_claude_design_to_fill.gap: There is no `:active` / pressed paint anywhere in v2 — no primitive, no theme.css rule. Every control goes rest → hover → (focus ring) with nothing in between.

Button `primary` and `danger` have NO hover at all (BTN_LOOK.primary.hover and .danger.hover are the empty string), so the app's two loudest controls are the only ones that do not react to the pointer.

Hover transitions are inconsistent: .v2-card / .v2-chip / .v2-dashadd / .v2-navlink animate at .12s, while .v2-act, .v2-bd, .v2-bdc, .v2-row, .v2-menuitem, .v2-hover-accent and .v2-hover-bad swap instantly. There is no motion token (`--dur-fast`, easing) — .12s is a literal repeated 11 times.
`prefers-reduced-motion` covers only .v2-grab and .v2-fold. The spinner animation, the Switch knob (150ms), the toast enter/leave (250ms) and the warm-start fade (.15s) are not covered.

The disabled recipe has six different treatments — Button (token swap, no dim), Input/Textarea/Select (0.6), Pill/IconButton/Chip/DashedAdd/MenuItem/Check/Radio/Switch/Segmented (0.5), ChoiceCard/ChoiceRow (0.45), MoveArrows (0.35), busy Button (0.6). No `--disabled-opacity` token exists, and there is no disabled ink token for a field.

No error / invalid / warning state exists for Input, Textarea or Select. There is no --input-border-error token; the three sites that need one set `borderColor: 'var(--bad)'` inline (Settings.jsx:934, LoginModal.jsx:73, and the Settings BOX).
readOnly on Input/Textarea passes through to the element with no distinct paint.

No loading/skeleton/empty-state primitive. Only Button and ScoreRing have a `busy`; `useSettled` explicitly ships no spinner ('the wait is a few hundred ms… a spinner would be one more thing appearing and disappearing').
No focus trap, no initial focus and no focus restore in ModalPanel, Drawer, ChoiceModal, ConfirmDialog or PromptDialog. Only Escape and a scrim click are wired. The body is not scroll-locked.

Select has no arrow-key navigation, typeahead, aria-activedescendant or aria-controls, and the trigger is a div rather than a combobox. Menu has no roving focus, no arrow keys, no Escape of its own — each row is an independent tab stop, and callers hand-roll a click-away backdrop div at a hand-picked z-index.
No minimum hit-target rule. Present sizes: MoveArrows 8px glyphs, RemoveX 11px, Check/Radio 14-15px, Switch track 26×15, Button xs 28px tall, IconButton 26×26. Nothing in the layer declares a floor.
The toast stack has no aria-live region and no role="status"/"alert"; its action link and its ✕ are bare spans with no role, no aria-label, no tab stop and no keyboard handler.
ConfirmDialog and PromptDialog do not wire aria-labelledby (their Heading has no id), so the dialog is announced without its title.
There is no ink/tone parameter on Helper (29 inline colour sites), Card (borderColor/background), Band, Link or Chip. Helper alone accounts for the largest single family of inline colour in v2.
There is no `pad` / `size` parameter on Card, Band, ModalPanel or Input, so padding is set inline at 23 + 8 + 12 + 5 sites respectively.

Four primitives read PALETTE tokens directly, breaking the layer's own rule: TableHead (--bg), Surface (--surface-2), Toast.jsx (--accent, --bad, --accent-ink, --rail-accent), ConfirmDialog.jsx (--muted). And Toast.jsx / ConfirmDialog.jsx set raw px font sizes (9.5, 11, 12, 12.5) instead of --t-* tokens.
RemoveX (default 11) and MoveArrows (8) set raw px font sizes outside the --t-* scale; Dot's `size` (7) and Spinner's `size` (9) are raw numbers too.

The rail has no semantic layer at all — --rail, --rail-ink, --rail-text, --rail-dim, --rail-accent, --rail-line and the --on-rail-* / --rail-active / --rail-hover overlays are palette names read straight by V2App and JobFeed. Six `ui: keep` sites exist purely because no primitive has an on-dark variant.

The ATS/search-mode hue taxonomy (--cc-* × 17, --sm-* × 6) is painted by a class, sits outside the semantic layer, and is deliberately excluded from every skin — so a skin cannot restyle a third of the badges on screen. Tag's `tone="none"` exists only to get out of its way.

z-index has no named scale. Twenty distinct literals are in use (2, 3, 18, 20, 21, 25, 29, 30, 34, 35, 39, 40, 44, 45, 50, 59, 60, 70, 80, 9998, 9999), most of them at a call site. ConfirmDialog stacking above a modal relies on DOM order at equal z-index.

A skin cannot express geometry today: --radius-*, --shadow-*, --t-* and every border width live in the shared semantic layer. Under the recorded decision ('skins may set radius/shadow/border-width: yes'), the per-skin set has to grow from 60 names to include the radius scale (10), the shadow scale (5), the type scale (20) and a border-width family that does not exist yet — and the skin proof has to be restated as 'only tokens may differ'.

There is no border-width token of any kind. `1px` is written as a literal 135 times in the screens and 20 times in ui.jsx; the Spinner's 1.5px, the focus ring's 2px, the chip halo's 2px and the grab handle's 3px are all literals too.

Sizes the primitives do not offer, each drawn by hand at multiple sites: a 25px pill (7 sites), a 24px toolbar trigger (4), a 25×25 and 22×22 and 16×16 and 15×15 icon box (9), a table BODY row at 32/34/38px (7), a modal FOOTER bar (11), a two-line option row (2), an on-dark control (6).
Two roles have no primitive at all: `Mono` (ids, timestamps, figures — 12 hand-drawn sites at 9.5/10/10.5/11/11.5 in five different inks) and `FooterRow` (the mirror of HeaderRow, rule on top).

Serif sizes 12, 20, 21, 23, 26 and 27 are drawn at 10 sites outside Heading's 18/19/22 (weight 400) and 15/15.5/16/17/18/19 (weight 500-600) tables, and there is no slot for a nested sans unit inside a serif numeral (Resumes' `17` + `/100`, JobFeed's `15` + `/20`).

The root line-height is inherited from the v1 shell's Tailwind preflight (1.5) rather than declared. Every fixed-height control opts out with `.v2-ctl { line-height:1 }` and every text role pins an integer line-height by hand.
Button has `as="button"` but no `as="a"` / `href`, so five sites that must stay real anchors (⌘/middle-click) hand-draw the button. MenuItem is the only primitive that solved this.

Input draws its own box, so nine composite fields (a bare input plus a ⌕, a show/hide toggle, an error tint, a ✦/↩ affordance) use a `v2-fieldwrap` div instead. There is no `Field` primitive with an adornment slot.

ChoiceRow's own radio disc is drawn from --choice-* tokens with no label colour, while the Radio primitive uses --check-* and a ● glyph, and JobFeed.jsx:1529 draws a third version. Three radio discs, three token families.
Settings.jsx:23's BOX const claims to be 'ui.jsx's Select trigger, to the pixel' but paints --surface where Select now paints --input-bg. The two have drifted and the comment has not.

The two 24px PDF-toolbar triggers use different hover classes for the same control — `v2-bd v2-ctl` in CoverLetterEditor, `v2-act` in ResumeEditor. Logged in-code as 'a needs-decision, not a licence to add a third'.

The light and dark semantic blocks are byte-identical, so no semantic token has ever been re-pointed per theme. The mechanism exists but has never been exercised — its behaviour under a skin that needs it is untested.

The board skins (cobalt, saas, win98) are palette-only imports of designs that also changed radii, bevels, shadows and the type scale. win98 additionally records two things a palette cannot fix: --bg is a DESKTOP colour, not a text ground (black ink reads 1.46:1 on the dark one), and its rail is LIGHT, so the white-alpha --rail-active / --rail-hover / --on-rail-* overlays vanish.

There are no breakpoints and no responsive tokens in theme.css. The only viewport-aware values are three `min(px, vh|vw)` literals in modal widths/heights, and one recorded fix for ≤1024px (the .v2-cactions pinned column).

IconButton at a size other than 26 or 36 gets the small look at that box — the intermediate is undefined. Meter's `tone` accepts an arbitrary `var(--…)` pass-through, an un-named escape from its five-name scale, and Dot is overridden the same way at three sites.
